Discovery & Library

Find your next obsession.

DG

Discovering Games

Featured titles, trending releases, community recommendations, and personalized suggestions tuned to your taste. Browse genre categories, editor's picks, seasonal collections, and the latest new releases — all surfaced through intelligent recommendations rather than paid placement.

GL

Game Library

Your installed games, favorites, and recently played titles live in one place. Track achievements, total playtime, and game ratings, and capture screenshots and clips that become part of your creator portfolio.

Progression

Every game builds the same identity.

UP

Unified Progression

Ecosystem-wide progression means achievements don't just fill a game-specific bar — they increase your EchoPlex Level, build your reputation, and unlock badges recognized across every product. A puzzle victory and a tournament win both strengthen the same identity.

AC

Achievements

From First Victory and Speed Runner to Puzzle Master, 100 Hours Played, and Tournament Champion — achievements mark meaningful milestones. Each one is permanently recorded on your profile and contributes to your ecosystem reputation.

Events & Competition

There's always something to play for.

DM

Daily Missions & Seasonal Events

Daily missions encourage you to play new games, help beginners, and join community events. Seasonal events like the Summer Festival, Winter Championship, and Creator Showcase bring the whole ecosystem together around shared themes.

CP

Competitive Play

Solo and team competitions, community-run tournaments, and regional and global championships give every skill level a stage. Winners earn ECP, badges, and ecosystem-wide recognition.

SG

Social Gaming

Friends lists, party systems, guild play, and cooperative missions make it easy to play together. Coordinate through Communities and keep your group connected across every game you share.

For Developers

Independent developers, welcomed.

ID

Independent Developers

Publishing tools, analytics, and revenue opportunities give indie developers a genuine path to be discovered by the community — without competing against paid promotion. Every published game connects to the creator's profile, journey, and marketplace.

FF

Fair Play Systems

Anti-cheat, transparent moderation, and community-driven reporting keep competition honest. Fair play isn't a feature — it's the foundation that makes progression and tournaments meaningful.

Ecosystem Connection

No game exists in isolation.

How Game Hub connects

A game developer publishes through Creator Hub. Players discover it in Game Hub. Fans discuss strategies and form teams in Communities. Collectibles and in-game assets appear in the Marketplace. Tournament winners earn ECP through TradeFusion. Every game becomes a thread in a wider web.

One identity, every game

Your achievements, playtime, and tournament record don't vanish when you close a game. They accumulate on a single EchoPlex identity that creators, communities, and the marketplace all recognize — so the more you play, the more the entire ecosystem reflects who you are.
